mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 2 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% each over the previous month signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO increase by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is at high levels.
